text:
Olivia (Product): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — we had a few asks about timing for three items: API rate-limit & routing revamp, Console workspace redesign, and Optimize recommendations (quantization + batching). I need a concise timeline we can post to the roadmap doc.

Mira (PM): Short answers:
- API revamp: beta early Q3 (targeting July), GA end of Q3 (Sept). Can roll out tiered rate limits in beta.
- Console redesign: canary mid-Q3, broader beta late Q3, GA in Q4.
- Optimize (quantization suggestions): internal pilot Q3, public recommendations and tooling Q4.

Ben (Eng): For the API revamp — is Dedicated capacity affected? Need to know if we require schema changes for routing policy.

Mira (PM): @Ben (Eng) Dedicated not affected for compatibility; routing is an opt-in policy feature. No breaking schema changes. We'll expose new fields under `routing_policy` and keep defaults backward-compatible.

Alex (DevEx): Any SDK version bump? We need to update clients before beta.

Mira (PM): Alex — yes minor SDK bump (semver minor). No behavioral breaking changes, but please add deprecation warnings in clients.

Sanjay (CTO): Priorities: API revamp > Console > Optimize for Q3. If capacity crunch, drop Console canary by 2 weeks not to impact API ship.

DeployBot: RFC merged: https://redwood.ai/rfc/api-revamp (summary in doc)

Olivia (Product): Great, I'll paste these into the roadmap doc and ping PMs with dates. @Mira please drop the beta signup form link when ready.

Mira (PM): Will do. :thumbsup:

Ben (Eng): I'll start a short PR for the `routing_policy` schema and add tests.

Alex (DevEx): Will coordinate SDK release notes. :shipit:

Olivia (Product): Thanks everyone — posting update in 30m. :tada:
